threads.body: Took me a while to figure out that this construct is used to get the parent span in `parent` variable. I'll replace it with the usual `trace.getSpan(0)`

Use `hasSpansSatisfyingExactly`: the callable probe finishes before the subscriber starts, and `TelemetryDataUtil` sorts the parent first and siblings by start time, independently of export order. The unordered assertion drops a deterministic ordering check required by `.github/instructions/java-tests.instructions.md:96–98`. Apply the same change in `AbstractRxJava2Test.java:314`.
